title: A'ja Wilson confronts Fevers fan during WNBA game, and now Sophie Cunningham has taken to social media to mock the Aces star - NewsBreak
text:
By Brendan McGilligan ,
5 hours ago IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Indiana Fever and Las Vegas Aces are battling it out for a place in the WNBA semi-finals. The teams are currently tied 1-1 in their three-game series. Las Vegas will host the final match of this series, as they finished higher in the division, so earning an advantage for the series. Fans of both franchises will be watching intently to see who will progress to face either the Dallas Wings or the Golden State Valkyries in the next stage of the competition.
The third game between the Fever and the Aces is set to be one full of fireworks after the second clash. The Fever won to keep their hopes alive, but it was the actions of A’ja Wilson that attracted the headlines. The Aces star received a technical foul after she confronted a Fever fan for pointing at her after she called for a foul on the floor. She wanted the fan removed from the stadium, but the Fever refused her request.
Now, Fever star Sophie Cunningham has taken to social media to mock Wilson and her encounter with the fan. Cunningham captioned her TikTok video, ‘according to the rule book’. It is believed to be in reference to many fans wanting Wilson suspended for going into the stands to confront a fan. This action is against WNBA rules. Whether the WNBA takes action remains to be seen, but this video will have just added an extra edge to the third game in the series between the teams.
Indiana Fever aiming to make WNBA history in 2026 The Fever finished sixth in the regular WNBA season, while the Aces finished third. Both sides had incredible seasons to reach the playoffs. However, the run ahead of this stage from the Aces was incredible. They were the form side in the competition, as they had been on a seven-game winning run before the playoffs. This form would have placed them among the favourites for the WNBA this season, meaning they would defend their crown.
In the first game of the series with the Fever, the three-time WNBA champions made eight wins in a row. It left a mountain for the Fever to climb, but they managed to achieve this and have set up a winner-takes-all clash between the pair. The Aces will be confident that, in front of their fans, they can progress. However, after their win last time out against the defending champions, the Fever will fully back themselves to be victorious.
Fans will be eagerly anticipating a match full of bite, as the two aim to make it to the semi-final. The Fever know they can secure their second-ever WNBA title this season, but in order to do so, they must overcome the Aces.
